description: Copy from one layer's property to properties on other layers: its keyframes (Edit > Copy and Paste, or Paste Reverse Keyframes with reverse), its expression only (Edit > Copy Expression Only), or a link: an expression on each target that follows the source, as Edit > Copy With Property Links then Paste, or dragging the expression pick whip, would write

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

property.description: A property: a shortcut (anchor_point, position, scale, rotation, opacity, x_rotation, y_rotation, orientation, source_text, time_remap, audio_levels) or a path of match names or display names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Effect Parade", "Gaussian Blur", "Blurriness"]

keys.description: With what: keyframes, which source keyframes. Which keyframes of the property: those matching any of indexes, the from/to time range, times or selected. Omit for all of them

from.description: Keyframes at or after this time (seconds)

selected.description: The keyframes selected in the Timeline panel

to.description: Keyframes at or before this time (seconds)

reverse.description: With what: keyframes, paste them in reverse time order (Paste Reverse Keyframes)

time.description: With what: keyframes, where the first pasted keyframe lands (seconds). Default the source times

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

property.description: A property: a shortcut (anchor_point, position, scale, rotation, opacity, x_rotation, y_rotation, orientation, source_text, time_remap, audio_levels) or a path of match names or display names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Effect Parade", "Gaussian Blur", "Blurriness"]. Default the source's path

what.description: keyframes, expression (the expression only), or link (a property link expression)

name: copy_animation
title: Copy Animation
